status: User accepted the 3 exact diagnostic sites on 2026-10-07. Focused qualification and its recorded limits are unchanged. Full RPM and native architecture qualification remain separate gates.
root_cause: The HoistType and ValueRepresentation switches initialize block/deopt_frame/untagged for every supported enumerator or terminate. GCC additionally considers unnamed enum values.
source_review: HoistType is private; its list starts at kNone and ProcessPhi assigns only kPrologue, kLoopEntryUnchecked or kLoopEntry. The reviewed branch executes only when its entry is not kNone.
ConvertTaggedPhiTo supports Int32, Float64 and HoleyFloat64. Every hoist case initializes both block and deopt_frame; unchecked loop entry intentionally uses a null deopt frame.
Each supported representation assigns untagged through one or two node constructions before change_input. All three unsupported declared representations terminate at UNREACHABLE.
NodeBase::New allocates from the V8 zone; allocation exhaustion terminates. The diagnostic adapter throws to test ownership and the absence of a committed phi change on failed allocation.

coverage.modes: Release/debug, both normal and Valgrind. Three hoist modes, all supported representations, two predecessor positions, loop/nonloop inputs, allocation failure at both node-construction positions, and every declared invalid-mode combination.
coverage.invariants: Checks emitted node sequence, predecessor/prologue block, exact deopt-frame identity, dataflow edges, final phi input and unchanged phi on allocation failure. Rejected modes allocate nothing.
coverage.compiler: All three original diagnostic variable names reproduce in both control builds.
coverage.memory: Both Valgrind runs report zero errors and all allocations freed.

limits: Verbatim enum definitions and complete hoisting branch are extracted with checksums. Typed block, node and zone adapters model graph construction, not machine-code execution or a complete engine.
UNREACHABLE throws a typed exception in the control; allocation failure is injected into the adapter. These are control-only changes.

The adapter static type is Smi, satisfying both Smi and Number checks. Numeric conversion semantics and full compiler graph reachability are outside this control; source review establishes accepted enum producers.
Initial container launch used the wrong uid and ran no tests; corrected uid 1019:100 matches the workspace.
No runtime patch, warning filter or package compiler-flag change is proposed.
